summary: Add the independent QA V2 path: explicit effective-version selection, bounded Canonical evidence bundles, claim-bound answers, optional local-region vision and a no-call legacy comparison gate.
decision_refs: Grill finding that retrieval and fragmented structural context, rather than OCR alone, dominate the sampled failures
approval_evidence: The user said to start implementation after allowing system-architecture refactoring of Feature 8.
known_limitations: A missing or ambiguous explicit issue date keeps competing documents active instead of guessing precedence.
Delta documents remain overlays and are not treated as whole-document replacements without explicit scope metadata.
Question-time vision is currently limited to the enabled DeepSeek vision route, one page and at most one overview plus one local crop.
The browser remains on the legacy endpoint until the fixed retrieval and answer gates pass on an explicitly authorized immutable staging database.
No credential access, paid call or customer database mutation is performed by the offline tests.
